China’s cultural industry is not competitive enough in the international market.

China's cultural industry is in the initial stage of development,with the export of cultural goods and services still dominated by the low-end products,with the export market share of high-end cultural products still very low,with the export competitiveness still weak and the export structure still unreasonable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Chinese cultural trade is in the process of transformation and upgrading,but there is still a long way to go.

the development of China's cultural industry should be based on the development of the domestic market,improve the quality and quantity of the domestic market and the international competitiveness of cultural products.
the development of Chinese cultural trade is still in the primary stage,and the core cultural products are still the main obstacle for the further development of cultural trade.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of China's cultural trade should be based on the core cultural content and should be oriented towards high-end products and high value-added services;at the same time,it should also pay attention to the peripheral cultural products and services,especially the cultural products and services which can be combined with the core cultural products and services.

the international competitiveness of Chinese cultural goods and services is relatively weak,and the international market share is low;the trade structure is unbalanced,and the export of core cultural products is relatively weak;the export of peripheral cultural products is relatively strong,but the export of core and peripheral cultural products is not coordinated.

the international competitiveness of Chinese cultural trade is weak,and the competitive advantage is unbalanced;China needs to strengthen the development of core cultural products,especially cultural and creative services,and enhance the competitiveness and influence of Chinese culture in the international cultural market.
